content_record.title: Mitochondrial mutations from past injuries quietly undermine your resilience
content_record.editorial_body: A new study shows that transient injuries trigger persistent mtDNA mutations that impair energy metabolism and increase future kidney injury risk—but adenosine repletion may restore ATP via AK4. Transient injuries cause persistent mtDNA mutations that impair resilience. Mutations suppress nucleotide metabolism; adenosine repletion restores ATP via AK4. In 369,912 UK Biobank participants, mutation burden linked to kidney disease severity. This signal is based on Reversible compromise of physiological resilience by accumulation of heteroplasmic mtDNA mutations. from PubMed. Read the original report for full context.
